svg.aria-label: Install: Download PrayDF-windows-x64.zip from the latest release. Extract praydf.exe and pdfium.dll into one folder, for example %LOCALAPPDATA%\PrayDF. Run praydf.exe --register once. PrayDF then appears under Open with for PDF files and can receive files from the extension. No administrator rights

g.text: Download PrayDF-windows-x64.zip from the latest release.
Extract praydf.exe and pdfium.dll into one folder, for example %LOCALAPPDATA%\PrayDF.
Run praydf.exe --register once. PrayDF then appears under Open with for PDF files and can receive
files from the extension. No administrator rights are needed; --unregister removes it again.
Download PrayDF-extension.zip from the same release and extract it.
Open the extensions page, turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked
Open about:debugging, choose This Firefox, then Load Temporary Add-on
and pick manifest.json. Allow access to all sites in about:addons under
Listings on the Chrome Web Store, Edge Add-ons, Firefox Add-ons and the Microsoft Store are on the roadmap.
